description: For a proper Boolean filter, maximality, exactly one choice in each complementary pair, and binary-join primeness are equivalent.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.ultrafilter_characterizations.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B]
  (F : Order.PFilter B) (hF : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsProperFilter F) :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter F ↔ ∀ (a : B), a ∈ F ↔ aᶜ ∉ F) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter F ↔ ∀ (a b : B), a ⊔ b ∈ F → a ∈ F ∨ b ∈ F)
